title: MuSeD: A Multimodal Spanish Dataset for Sexism Detection in Social Media Videos

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot binary classification (sexist vs. non-sexist) of social media video transcripts and multimodal visual frames using LLMs and Vision-Language Models, evaluating their ability to detect gender stereotypes, inequality, and objectification.

Evaluating models on their ability to classify video content containing discrimination and prejudice against non-heterosexual identities (e.g., gays, lesbians, bisexuals) as a sub-category of the dataset's expanded definition of sexism.
Evaluating models on their ability to detect discriminatory content targeting transgender and non-binary individuals, also classified under the dataset's expanded sexism framework.
